sections.title: Credits
sections.text: Thank you to everyone who contributed to this validated design guidance. This cross-functional team, representing many departments within HashiCorp, authored, edited, reviewed, and iterated this content to provide prescription and recommendations for using HashiCorp software in enterprise scenarios.
